Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item

Class Inventory

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item.Inventory
public class Inventory extends Object
The player's pack: an ordered list of item stacks with a fixed number of slots. Stackable items merge into an existing stack of the same kind and do not use a new slot. Each slot is addressed by a letter, 'a' for the first.
